title: V.Knasiaus KM claim MKL U19 title
description: V.Knasiaus KM celebrated the MKL U19 title. They beat Panevezio 86-83 in the Final game in Siauliai. Mintautas Mockus (201-G-2003) was unstoppable with 24 points and 19 rebounds for the champions. Panevezio dominated in the first half. They recorded a 43-38 halftime lead. Panevezio controlled the tempo throughout the third term. They entered the final period up by five points. But V.Knasiaus KM responded with a 21-13 rally in the fourth quarter to snatch the victory. Kristupas Keinys (199-SF-2004) tossed in 18 points in the win. Dominykas Butka (198-SG-2003) answered with 24 points and 9 rebounds for Panevezio.
